'''Cuebiyarsande''' was a city in the nation of [[Aramaelle]], which was part of the [[Ten Nations]]. Aside from the name, nothing else is know about it. {{ref|{{bwb}}, Ch10}}

Its name translated into the Common Tongue is possibly "Rose of our Heart" - from the [[Old Tongue]] words ''cuebiyar'' (meaning "(my) heart; capitalized, it refers to the heart of the nation or people, or the heart of a ruler") and ''ande'' (meaning "rose"). {{ref|{{twotc}}, Old Tongue}}
